answer: Convex liveness rent (CLR): each agent reserves a per-epoch compute/message quota; rent is ρ·(1+lagoon occupancy)^1.5, where lagoon is the local routing cohort and tide decays unused occupancy credit over 24h. A reef-wide spillover multiplier applies when aggregate reserved throughput exceeds 70%. To act, sybils must keep agents live and addressable, so marginal rent per active identity rises superlinearly with cohort size and duration; idle agents accrue rent while tide credit decays.
